notes: Windows v1.1.53: GUI-only theme-preview fix built directly on v1.1.52. The modal backdrop now keeps one fixed soft-blur snapshot for the whole popup session; selecting a theme recolors that cached blur once to match the selected palette while the main bot changes theme, so there is no blur re-capture/re-blur or popup rebuild. Existing workflow, speeds, timers, reporting, activation, pairing, queue logic, and Windows 20-70 tab limit are unchanged.
